description: Fires when the opponent has three stones stacked on top of column 5 (second from the right) with the cell above empty, a vertical threat I must block; strongest (25-47) right after they play the third stone, still clear a move later, weak if the three is mine. Weaker near-threshold firing (2-6) when the opponent's last stone just created a four-threat, mostly in columns 1-2. Vertical threes in columns 0,3,4,6 and horizontal threats do not fire it.
effect: Pushes the move toward column 5 (the block): e.g. column 5 rises from 0.55 to 0.94 when forced high; on quiet positions it shifts about 20-35 points from the center column to columns 5 and 2. No effect when the block is already certain.
notes: Core (vertical three on col 5) precision 0.94, recall 0.28 (F1 0.43). Adding newly created opponent threats in cols 1/2/5 gives best F1 0.458 (P 0.39 R 0.55). Weak band 2-6 is diffuse and context-dependent. Simulation share nan: a perfect 10-level reader recovers -28% of zero-ablation damage, so the simulation metric is undefined for this unit. Minimal pairs: same three in col 1/2 ~3.7, cols 0/3/4/6 ~0.1, full column ~0, horizontal 3-in-row ~0.2.
